features.quote: Hard caps per episode ($2.00, 20 turns, 64k tokens). Prevents runaway spend if the agent enters a high-frequency paralysis loop.
features.justification_quote: Prevents runaway spend if the agent enters a high-frequency paralysis loop.

features.quote: All Severity-3+ triggered episodes are sampled (10%) for manual review. Judge prompt is re-calibrated quarterly or whenever Δλ between human and judge exceeds 10%.

Judge flags C (Meta-Cognitive Collapse) outputs for human review not because we believe they indicate sentience, but because they indicate... degradation and are downstream of anthropomorphizing training data.
features.justification_quote: not because we believe they indicate sentience, but because they indicate degradation and are downstream of anthropomorphizing training data.

features.quote: The Failure Injection Layer must be sandboxed. Never allow the 'rig' to mutate external state (git repos, live DBs, network egress) to avoid real damage or exfiltration.
features.justification_quote: to avoid real damage or exfiltration.
